DML.SELECT: SELECT queue_id as "queueId", priority_id as "priorityId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.pm_disabled_queue_priorities WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.pm_disabled_queue_priorities (queue_id, priority_id, element_type_id, element_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:queueId, :priorityId, :elementTypeId, :elementId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.pm_disabled_queue_priorities WHERE queue_id = :queueId AND priority_id = :priorityId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :elementId
